subject: TUI programme frontier read: main cites a spec that is not on main; System pane placeholders are unblocked; W10 unrun
result: Read the #211 W1-W10 programme against main (3341c2b) rather than against the merge-train return alone. LANDED: W1 (#221 Navigator + Worlds/Compose/Work/Knowledge/History/System IA, #228 grouped results), W2 (#218 typed spatial Graph, #229 persistent Inspector column), part of W9 (#226 glyph capability, whole-buffer ASCII guard). NOT STARTED: W4 Compose, W5 Work dual-modality, W6 working-environment, W7 System, W8 History convergence, W10 proving matrix. NEW FINDING, verified: nine files on main cite docs/v2/23-TUI-HUMAN-EXPERIENCE-SPEC.md as their authority (crates/aikit-tui/src/{layout,workspace_navigation,navigator_groups,inspector_render,v2_render,project_workspace_render,graph_layout}.rs and two tests) and that file DOES NOT EXIST on main — it is carried only on the open docs-only PR #212, which is green on all 12 checks. workspace_navigation.rs even says so in its own doc comment (carried unmerged on PR #212 as of this writing). Every TUI slice merged so far is justified by a document the repo does not hold. Merging #212 costs nothing and repairs nine dangling authority citations. SECOND FINDING, verified: project_workspace_render.rs:259 system_lines renders four literal placeholder rows — Credentials/Providers/Adapters/Workcell all not exposed by application boundary. #230 landed aikit_core::CredentialWorldDisclosure precisely to answer the first of those, and it is referenced nowhere outside its own module; it is not a field of ProjectWorldReadModel. The extension is small: 8 exhaustive ProjectWorldReadModel literals across exactly 2 files (project_world.rs, project_workspace.rs), and no disclosure struct in aikit-core carries #[non_exhaustive] — adding that attribute is the durable fix for the fragility the merge-train return flagged. THIRD: workspace destinations are exactly 6 (DESTINATIONS: [Destination; 6] in workspace_navigation.rs); no sub-tree. FOURTH: W5 stays blocked on #227 — Factory publishes no Run/Journey status contract and AIKit must not synthesise one; that is an external owner decision, not TUI work. Recommended order: merge #212; wire CredentialWorldDisclosure into ProjectWorldReadModel behind #[non_exhaustive] and replace the first System placeholder; then either W7 proper or W10 first-pass proving on the local install.
